"""Generate the fixed-instance keyboard-out-of-bin trajectory."""
import numpy as np
import rcb_robolab as rcb
from rcb_robolab import Session

s = Session("keyboard_out_of_bin", instance="/app/instance.json")
p = s.primitives()
s.reset()
s.record_start()

# Approach the keyboard at its exposed high end. Align the fingertip frame's
# closing axis with the keyboard face normal and its approach axis with the
# keyboard's long axis.
obj = s.objects()["keyboard"]
R = rcb.quat_to_mat(np.asarray(obj["orientation_wxyz"], dtype=np.float64))
long_axis = R[:, 0]
face_normal = R[:, 2]
side_axis = np.cross(long_axis, face_normal)
grasp_quat = rcb.mat_to_quat(np.column_stack([face_normal, side_axis, long_axis]))
center = np.asarray(obj["position"], dtype=np.float64)
grasp_pos = center + R @ np.array([-0.15, 0.0, -0.012])
pregrasp_pos = center + R @ np.array([-0.30, 0.0, -0.012])

p["open_gripper"](5)
p["move_ee"](pregrasp_pos, p["top_down_quat"](0.0), speed=0.20)
p["move_ee"](pregrasp_pos, grasp_quat, speed=0.12)
p["move_ee"](grasp_pos, grasp_quat, speed=0.10)
p["close_gripper"](20)
p["hold"](5)

# Lift with the measured current pose as the origin, allowing the board to
# settle against the gripper while clearing the bin rim.
ee_pos, _ = s.ee_pose()
p["move_ee"](
    ee_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.22]),
    grasp_quat,
    speed=0.15,
    max_dq=0.08,
    tol=0.03,
    rot_tol=0.35,
    max_steps=180,
)
p["hold"](5)

actions = s.record_stop()
s.save_trajectory(
    actions,
    "/app/output/trajectory.npz",
    meta={"method": "edge grasp and lift", "instance": "/app/instance.json"},
)
print({"actions": len(actions), **s.status()})
